report.answer: The structural map engine lives in internal/mapengine/ (types.go, goast.go, treesitter.go, regex.go). Engine selection happens automatically in mapAuto() in types.go: `.go` files use GoASTMapper (go/ast), `.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.py/.rs` use TreeSitterMapper (gotreesitter) via mapTreeSitterWithFallback, and everything else falls back to RegexMapper — with tree-sitter/go-ast failures also falling back to regex; a `--map-engine` flag can force EngineRegex or EngineTreeSitter explicitly via the top-level Map() dispatcher.
